content.title: Blue Owl Stock Is Unjustly Cheap, Says Raymond James
content.summary: Shares of the private credit manager  Blue Owl Capital  have been sapped by worries about nonbank lending, as well as a failed merger between two of its funds.  The fears for  Blue Owl  are overwrought, however, says Raymond James analyst Wilma Burdis.  The $16.67 stock trades at just 17-times its next 12 months’ earnings—compared with 20 times to 30 times for its alternative asset manager peers.
